company: Pushp Brand (India) Ltd., Sanwer Road, Indore (M.P.) - est. 1974

Listed instead are the Pushp packs a namkeen shop is most likely to stock: Indori poha/jeeravan masala, chaat, jal-jeera, chhach, sandwich and achar (pickle) masalas. MRPs are the 'MRP' shown on Pushp's official store pushponline.com (Oct 2026); store sells below MRP. Category 'Masala': Pushp makes no namkeen/bakery/pickle/sweet product, so no store category fits.

company: Athavale's (आठवलेज्) - a unit of Sushila Gruh Udyog, Hingne Khurd, Pune 411051; since 1970; FSSAI 11517036000550
notes: Owner wrote 'Aathavlez'. Identified with high confidence as Athavale's, a Pune Maharashtrian snack/sweet maker. Its logo is in Devanagari, 'आठवलेज्' (Aathavlej), and the site header and logo file read 'ATHAVLES'. 'Aathavlez' is a phonetic transliteration of that logo, and a Pune brand fits a Hadapsar shop. It is NOT an Indori brand. Range: chakli, chivda, bakarwadi, shankarpale, sev, upwas (fasting) snacks, ladoo, barfi and wadi. The official Shopify store is the primary source. Veg mark not stated in page text, so veg=null. Most official photos show the pack beside a bowl of product on a light-grey background; pack-only shots were used where they exist. Prices are the official athavales.com price ('Inclusive of all taxes', Oct 2026); the site does not label them 'MRP', so confirm against the printed pack MRP.
